properties: Before, at and after exact completion retain correct source identities
Delayed receipt blocks use until known time
Changing a later observation cannot alter earlier decisions
Input order cannot select a future observation
Latest missing value stays missing instead of falling back to an older value
False and numeric zero remain valid, distinct values
No previous observation and expiry boundary stay unavailable
Equivalent UTC and fixed-offset times select the same observation
Invalid time order, validity and offset-free timestamps fail explicitly
Repeated views and input order do not change earliest distinct-pair rows
Different observation identities remain separate when values happen to match
Session is retained in the distinct-pair key
Completed selector rejects developing or unknown-completion observations
inputs: Only invented dated examples, no market observations.
limits: Checks establish the stated teaching contract, not private-engine correctness, actual source timing, independent sample size or trading value.
